h1: Land Rover Engine Components We Replace

blocks.html: A full engine rebuild replaces all wear-prone internal components, returning your Land Rover's engine to manufacturer specifications. We use OEM-quality parts and follow JLR service tolerances throughout the process.

**Included as standard:** pistons & rings, bearings (main, big-end, thrust), timing chains/tensioners/guides, oil pump, water pump, all gaskets & seals, and full machining of the block and cylinder head.

The components listed here are replaced as standard on every rebuild we perform, across all Land Rover models and engine families.

Key engine families covered: [Td5](/landrover-td5-engine), [300Tdi](/landrover-300tdi-engine), [200Tdi](/landrover-200tdi-engine), [AJ200D](/landrover-aj200d-engine), [AJ300D](/landrover-aj300d-engine), [AJ133](/landrover-aj133-engine), [Ford EcoBoost](/landrover-ford-ecoboost-engine), [Ford Duratorq](/landrover-ford-duratorq-engine), and more.

items: All new bearings, pistons, rings, chains, gaskets & seals
Full machine shop: boring, honing, grinding, balancing

items.a: Yes — every rebuild includes new pistons, rings, bearings, timing components, oil & water pumps, and all gaskets & seals. Machining of the block and cylinder head is also performed.

items.q: Do you use OEM parts or aftermarket?
items.a: We use OEM-quality components from recognised suppliers that meet or exceed JLR specifications. When available, genuine Land Rover parts are used.

items.q: Is the cylinder head always machined?
items.a: Yes — every cylinder head is planed (resurfaced) and pressure-tested as part of the rebuild to ensure a perfect seal.
Supercharged engines (AJ133) also include replacement of supercharger seals, gaskets, and oil during the rebuild.

items.q: Do you replace timing belts on older engines?
items.a: Yes — for engines with timing belts (200Tdi/300Tdi, some Duratorq), we replace the belt, tensioner, and any related pulleys.
All rebuilds are backed by a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.
